title: Highways in every land
changes: Every homeland now has its own wide cobbled highway: the Sunscar, the Grey Barrow Moors, the Red Badlands and the Mawdeep Sinkholes. Each runs from the clan city's gate past the capital to the main town, every village and every border pass.
In the Crown of the Marches the king's roads are joined up: from Tollcross Square down to the ring road round the Keep, and on to all five passes.
New signposts at the highways' forks always point the way back to each land's capital and main town, or to Tollcross in the Crown.
